name: Fiscal policy

subjectOf.text: Increasing the commercial benefits attached to a token heightens the aggregate demand for that token's given supply, which is why benefit adjustment functions as a quasi-fiscal policy tool.
subjectOf.abstract: First, the increase in commercial benefits associated with a token heightens the aggregate demand of the given token supply.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860

subjectOf.text: Commercial benefits attached to a token issuance can offset depreciated supply scarcity, meaning the dilutive effects of a large supply of the token in circulation.
subjectOf.abstract: Second, commercial benefits associated with a token issuance can help offset depreciated supply scarcity, e.g. the effects of a large issuance / supply of a given token in circulation.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860
scope_conditions: issuances with large token supply in circulation

subjectOf.text: Adjusting the commercial benefits of a token issuance lets the issuer avoid more drastic monetary interventions such as emergency sales, building token reserves, or changing the token supply in circulation.
subjectOf.abstract: Fourth, adjusting the commercial benefits associated with a given token issuance avoids more drastic monetary policy intervention by way of emergency sales, building token reserves, or a decrease or increase of token supply in circulation.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860

subjectOf.text: Combining quasi-fiscal policy, increasing benefits attached to tokens, with monetary policy, increasing supply in circulation, may or may not have an effect on the market price of the tokens.
subjectOf.abstract: The combined effect of quasi-fiscal policy (increasing benefits associated with the tokens) and monetary policy (increasing the token supply in circulation) may or may not have an effect on the market price of the respective tokens.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860
scope_conditions: when benefit increases and supply increases are applied simultaneously

subjectOf.text: Fiscal stimulus cannot restore employment that has been structurally eliminated by autonomous agents able to perform the same tasks at zero marginal cost, so the Keynesian transmission mechanism from aggregate demand to employment dissolves.
subjectOf.abstract: Fiscal stimulus designed to increase aggregate demand cannot restore employment that has been structurally eliminated by autonomous agents capable of performing the same tasks at zero marginal cost.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Collapse of Scarcity Economics (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6421319
scope_conditions: applies where AI substitutes for labor across cognitive and physical domains
